meta.title: fix: mise up parallel execution
meta.body_summary: Enable parallel installation for mise upgrade to improve performance by refactoring the installation pipeline to run tool upgrades concurrently.

perf_labels.notes: Parallel upgrade refactoring with dense bot reviews; merged despite CI regressions after iterative fixes.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 1473 changed lines across 8 files, this is a medium-to-large refactor concentrated in src/toolset/mod.rs (77% of changes). It represents a significant rework of the installation pipeline to support parallelism, with a large number of iterative commits and bot reviews. Merged after extensive iteration.

review_details.concern_detail: Multiple bot reviews (cursor and copilot) repeatedly pointed out issues with using tset.len() as task ID, potential panics, incorrect result ordering, and premature returns on plugin/semaphore errors. The maintainer iterated over many commits to address these.
review_details.performance_claim: Enable parallel installation for mise upgrade to improve performance.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The agent-assisted (Cursor) implementation involved complex concurrency patterns (JoinSet, task tracking) that required multiple bot reviews and iterative human fixes to achieve correctness; CI performance regressions were noted but not blocking.

detection_detail.code_reading: Cursor bot reviewed code for concurrency bugs and reported issues via PR comments; maintainer used 'bugbot run' to trigger deeper analysis.
detection_detail.ci_auto: GitHub Actions CI posted Hyperfine and xtask performance comparisons, which showed regressions on uncached install and bin-paths.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: CI posted performance comparisons, but the PR body contained no benchmarks; the performance claim was not substantiated with specific metrics.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Hyperfine showed install uncached 768ms -> 1090ms (-29%) and bin-paths uncached 697ms -> 1004ms (-30%); no action taken.

core_change_summary.description: Refactored installation pipeline in src/toolset/mod.rs to support parallel tool upgrades: replaced sequential per-tool loop with JoinSet-based concurrent tasks, introduced InstallFailed error variant to report partial successes/failures, and added e2e test cases for parallel failure scenarios. Also touched upgrade.rs, install.rs, lockfile.rs, errors.rs, env.rs.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Other files were updated to use new error handling and support parallel execution; lockfile refactoring is minor style change.
change_trajectory: Initial commit 'feat(upgrade): parallel upgrade' introduced parallel execution in upgrade.rs and toolset/mod.rs.
Multiple 'v2' commits iteratively fixed concurrency bugs flagged by cursor and copilot bot reviews, adding full error tracking (task_tools, plugin_errors).
Introduced InstallFailed error variant, refined task joining, and added RUST_BACKTRACE support for debugging.
Final commits cleaned up result collection ordering and removed redundant code.

review_signals.summary: Identified multiple bugs: config isolation, ignored --raw flag, premature returns, task ID tracking panics, misattribution of errors.
review_signals.action_taken: Maintainer addressed many issues in subsequent commits.

review_signals.summary: Provided PR overviews and low-confidence style suggestions (e.g., redundant data structures, task ID fragility).
Noted that the refactoring is a huge pain as install_all_versions isn't designed for this.
Invoked 'bugbot run' multiple times to trigger Cursor bot analysis.
Hyperfine and xtask benchmarks showed performance regressions (~30% slowdown on uncached install and bin-paths).

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with initial parallel upgrade implementation.
Cursor bot immediately flagged concurrency bugs; maintainer commented it's a huge pain and moved to draft.
Over 8 days, maintainer iterated heavily with ~15 additional commits, fixing issues and adding error handling infrastructure.
Multiple 'bugbot run' invocations triggered deeper analysis; Copilot bot also provided frequent overviews.
CI performance report showed regressions on uncached operations; maintainer proceeded to merge.
Merged after resolving bot-identified issues, accepting minor regression.
